build_numerics_instance: build a numerics.Numerics instance with optional resistivity_multiplier parameter
build_geometry_circular: build a circular geometry from CircularConfig and access its torax_mesh
set_grid_numerics: set the grid on a numerics instance using torax_pydantic.set_grid with geometry mesh
build_runtime_params: build runtime parameters from a numerics instance at a given time value
test_numerics_under_jit: test that numerics build_runtime_params works correctly under jax.jit without recompilation
